what: A carousel of landscape photo panels drawn with a three.js orthographic camera. Each panel follows its target position with damping of 25 per second, but panels ahead in the direction of motion move faster (trailing panels 30% slower). The photo inside a panel lags the panel by another .267, so a photo scaled to 1.1 slides sideways inside the panel window and eases back (panel-position parallax .02, bounded with tanh). Transitions run 600ms with 1-(1-t)³. Pressing at the last section goes back through every section to the first in 600 + 35×section count ms. Dragging is handled by Swiper touch: dragging past 15% of the panel width advances, and short of that the panel returns in place in 250~300ms. Clicking a panel goes to the next section, and the ← → keys also navigate. A 1px progress bar below fills up to the current section. The canvas is widened to the full screen width so neighboring sections peek out at the sides.

options.loop-per: Length added per slide when going back from the end to the first (sec), default .035
options.power: Exponent of the flip curve 1-(1-t)^power, default 3
options.stagger: Shrink ratio from the front panel to the back panel, default .3
options.lag: Ratio at which the image trails behind the panel, default .267
options.parallax: Photo shift by panel position, default .02
options.threshold: Ratio at which a drag turns over (board width), default .15
options.gap: Gap between panels (px, 1200 and above), default 30
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Board that holds the canvas — position and width follow the host css (usually full screen width)
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: One sheet slot (base board) — this width and slot is the current sheet
options.[data-fx-part=swiper]: Swiper panel inside the frame (.swiper > .swiper-wrapper) — fills as many transparent cells as sections so Swiper actually slides (drag · section change), and the canvas follows that slide
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: One per section — data-label (placeholder image text) or an img inside

use: …
note: As in the original, a transparent Swiper panel handles drag · section change (it actually moves by panel width + gap) and three.js draws the panel row graphics directly — the original’s virtual slides are not used. Shaders are precompiled at setup

from.where: about.html .ns-value-images (below the values list, a 6–20-column photo board of 20 photos at 952:582, with the canvas running to the screen’s edge — original about value carousel: BASE_SPEED 600 · LOOP 600+35/photo · TRANSITION_EASING_POWER 3 · FRAME_DAMPING_RATE 25 · FRAME_STAGGER_RATIO .3 · IMAGE_LAG_RATIO .267 · PARALLAX_ZOOM 1.1 · PARALLAX_STRENGTH .02 · SWIPE_SLIDE_CHANGE_THRESHOLD .15 · spaceBetween 16/30)
